attorneys: Joseph L. Freiman for appellant., Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, Theodore I. Botter, Assistant Attorney General, and Herman D. Ringle for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents. Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
